channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado é certeiro no que é ruim e incerto no que é imprescindível
item.description: With 40 days left until the election, Ronaldo Caiado missed the chance to position the third way during a live interview on TV Globo. He was categorical in criticizing amnesty for coup supporters but avoided detailing his economic platform, saying he couldn't go into specifics. His stance drew criticism for lack of clarity on essential proposals.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no 1º turno em Tocantins, indica Real Time Big Data
item.description: A new poll by Real Time Big Data in Tocantins, conducted between August 21 and 25, 2026, shows President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) tied at 36% in the first-round preference. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio leads with 45% against Lula's 39%.

item.title: “Lulinha virou craque dos negócios”, diz Rogério Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho criticized Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, by suggesting he lives in luxury in Madrid, Spain, while corruption scandals involving the INSS are being investigated in Brazil. Marinho also shared an AI-generated image showing Lulinha in Spain, questioning whether influence was used for private business gain.

item.title: Manchester City anuncia a contratação de Bouaddi, joia de Marrocos
item.description: Manchester City announced the signing of Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi, who played for Morocco in the 2026 World Cup. The player, previously with Lille, signed a five-year contract until 2030/2031, with the transfer valued at around €95 million. Bouaddi, born in France, captained Morocco's midfield in the 1-1 draw against Brazil during the World Cup.

item.title: Real Time Big Data em Tocantins: Dorinha e Vicentinho empatam em 1º e 2º turnos
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows a technical tie between Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) and Deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) in first and second round simulations for governor of Tocantins, with a two-point margin of error. Vice-governor Laurez Moreira (PSD) ranks third in the first round and does not advance to the second round.

item.title: Flávio tem 47% e Lula, 42% em 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on August 26, 2026, shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 47% of voting intentions against 42% for President Lula (PT) in a potential second round. The survey also found that 51% of voters disapprove of Lula's administration. The study surveyed 2,400 voters between August 21 and 25, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: O estado onde eleitores ‘lulistas’ admitem votar no governador da direita
item.description: Quaest polls reveal that 70% of Southern voters remain undecided for governor. Despite strong anti-PT sentiment, conservative leaders like Jorginho Mello lead, even attracting some 'Lula' supporters. Preference for Bolsonaro-aligned figures persists, but voter intentions remain highly unstable ahead of October elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro queima largada e apela por voto útil da direita
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) kicked off his early campaign and called for a 'useful vote' to consolidate the right-wing against rivals like Caiado, Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury. This rushed move signals insecurity and may damage alliances ahead of a potential runoff.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Real Time Big Data testa disputa Lula x Flávio após entrevistas e início da campanha na TV
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data survey measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, analyzing voting intentions, rejection rates, electoral potential, and opinion indicators about the country. Data collection runs from June 26 to 29, covering the start of the electoral campaign on TV and radio. The poll includes first and second-round simulations with multiple candidates.

item.title: Caiado critica a reforma tributária e diz que pretende modificá-la
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the tax reform approved by Congress and said he intends to modify it if elected. The statements were made during an interview on the Jornal Nacional newscast on TV Globo.

item.title: Lula passou a ser um grande agiota, diz Caiado, sobre o endividamento do brasileiro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD candidate for the presidency, referred to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'loan shark' during a TV Globo interview, criticizing the Desenrola Brasil program and the Brazilian people's debt. The statement occurred on Tuesday, 25th, and emphasized his stance on economic policies.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no Amazonas, segundo pesquisa Real Time Big Data
item.description: A survey by the Real Time Big Data institute shows that President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are tied in the preference of Amazonas voters for the 2026 presidential race. In the first round, Lula leads by one percentage point (40% vs 39%), while in the second round the order inverts (43% for Flávio and 41% for Lula). The gap falls within the two-point margin of error.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Flávio Bolsonaro faz motociata, Lula encontra Motta e Alcolumbre
item.description: On Wednesday, August 26, 2026, President Lula (PT) has no campaign schedule and is in Brasília meeting with the presidents of the Chamber and Senate to discuss governmental agendas, including pension reform. Meanwhile, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) maintains an active agenda in Arapiraca, Alagoas, with a motorcycle parade, rally, and meetings with the productive sector. Other candidates such as Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, and Renan Canto also carry out regional activities and media appearances.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: Capitão Alberto Neto lidera disputa pelo Senado no Amazonas
item.description: Federal deputy Capitão Alberto Neto (PL) leads Senate vote intentions in Amazonas with 24%, followed by Wilson Lima (União Brasil) and Eduardo Braga (MDB) tied at 19% and 18% respectively, according to Real Time Big Data survey with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Daniel Perez, nominated as future U.S. ambassador to Brazil, states he will not involve himself in Brazilian politics and will respect the October election outcome, working with whoever wins. His statement reflects a stance of neutrality and respect for Brazil's democratic process.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 4ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE will be released for publication starting Wednesday (August 26, 2026), covering 7 Brazilian states. The content does not mention specific candidates, focusing only on the rules for publishing polling data.

item.title: Novas pesquisas mostram disputa Lula x Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do Brasil
item.description: The Quaest polls show that the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is extremely tight in Brazil's three largest electoral colleges, with margins of at most two percentage points. In São Paulo and Minas Gerais, the candidates are tied when Pablo Marçal is included, while in Rio de Janeiro, Flávio holds a slight numerical lead.

item.title: Plenário do STF: saiba quais ações estão na pauta desta 4ª feira
item.description: The STF will rule on Wednesday on actions regarding the Public Ministry's subpoena powers and the financial proof requirement for free legal aid in Labor Justice. The court, now composed of 10 ministers following Barroso's retirement, examines cases involving checks and balances between powers and access to justice.

item.title: Governo Lula: leia a agenda de ministros do governo nesta 4ª feira
item.description: President Lula's ministers are set for a busy schedule on August 26, 2026, with meetings at the Alvorada Palace and official trips to São Paulo, Pernambuco, South Africa, and China. Key activities include engagements with the private sector, delivery of quilombola housing, and agendas on culture and urban infrastructure. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira leads a diplomatic mission to South Africa, strengthening international cooperation.

item.title: Saiba o que os candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 4ª feira
item.description: Presidential candidates carry out campaign activities on August 26, 2026, with meetings, motorcycle parades, and institutional visits. Lula meets with ministers and congressional leaders to discuss tax exemptions on international purchases. Other candidates also hold regional events and interviews.

item.title: Boulos estreia live semanal para mobilizar militância de Lula
item.description: Guilherme Boulos launches a weekly live stream to mobilize Lula's base and provide political analysis. The effort underscores the campaign's strategy to deepen direct engagement with supporters during the electoral race.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 4ª
item.description: President Lula has a schedule in Brasília with ministers and congressional leaders to discuss the Provisional Measure that eliminated the 20% tax on international purchases up to $50. The MP may lose validity on September 8 if not approved by the legislature.

item.title: Aziz lidera disputa pelo governo do Amazonas em 1º turno, aponta Real Time Big Data
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz (PSD) leads the race for Amazonas governor in the first round with 34% of voting intentions, according to a Real Time Big Data survey. Roberto Cidade (União Brasil) and Professor Maria do Carmo (PL) are tied for second place with 22% and 21% respectively. Three of the six second-round simulations show technical ties, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Lulinha pede indenização a Alfredo Gaspar na Justiça por vídeo
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, filed a lawsuit seeking R$ 10 million in moral damages against federal congressman Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) over a video accusing him of corruption. The lawsuit also requests a ban on republishing the content and the preservation of social media records.

item.title: Não me envolverei em eleição, diz nomeado para embaixada dos EUA
item.description: Daniel Perez, nominated by Trump as U.S. Ambassador to Brazil, stated he will not intervene in Brazilian elections, emphasizing respect for the local democratic process. Although awaiting approval from Lula's government, his statements come after 17 months without an ambassador amid diplomatic tensions.

item.title: Nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus testa disputa Lula x Flávio após início da campanha na TV
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll, the 12th national round, investigates the dispute between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro following the start of the electoral campaign on TV and radio. It will survey 2,000 voters from May 28 to 30, featuring simulations of first and second-round scenarios, along with analysis of voting motivation—whether based on positive agenda or strategic vote to defeat the opponent. The survey also tests other matchups with Zema, Caiado, Renan Santos, and Pablo Marçal.

item.title: Capital do Sul lidera qualidade de vida entre as capitais brasileiras e combina parques gigantes, clima mais frio e bairros arborizados com estrutura de cidade grande
item.description: The southern capital of Curitiba leads the 2026 Index of Quality of Life of Capitals (IPS) Brazil ranking, standing out for its large parks, tree-lined neighborhoods, cooler climate, and consolidated urban infrastructure. These elements create a sustainable and pleasant city model, distinct from other Brazilian metropolises.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro convoca ato na Paulista em 7 de setembro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) called supporters for a rally on Paulista Avenue on September 7, 2026, urging political, religious, and community leaders to mobilize for the event. His official campaign kickoff took place in Copacabana, Rio, on August 16, drawing about 8,900 attendees.

item.title: Perito diz que não rastreou origem de dinheiro de “Dark Horse”
item.description: A private expert hired by GoUp Entertainment did not trace the origin of funds from the Havengate fund that financed the movie 'Dark Horse', claiming no authorization to audit the entity. The Jair Bolsonaro biographical film remains under Federal Police investigation regarding potential resource diversion, with links pointed between Flávio Bolsonaro, Daniel Vorcaro, and Paulo Calixto.

item.title: Flávio e o filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received R$16 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about his father, but 89.1% of respondents believe he will never account for the funds. Most readers doubt any transparency regarding the money.

item.title: Lula reúne Motta e Alcolumbre para avançar pautas do governo
item.description: President Lula meets with the presidents of the Chamber and Senate to advance agendas such as the MP ending the 'suitcases tax' and the 6 X 1 scale. The provisional measure, which still charges ICMS on international purchases, must be approved by September 8th. The meeting aims to jointly announce the end of taxation.

item.title: Ativa nas redes, amiga de Lulinha exibia proximidade com ministros
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, displayed photos on social media with various ministers and authorities, suggesting closeness to the Lula administration. She faces investigations into alleged corruption, influence peddling, and money laundering.

item.title: ‘Já não temos muita esperança’, diz Paulo Galo às vésperas de julgamento no STF
item.description: Paulo Galo, app delivery worker and movement leader, expresses distrust in institutions ahead of a Supreme Court hearing on labor rights. The case involves Uber and debates whether an employment relationship exists between platforms and workers. Galo highlights achievements from strikes, such as the minimum delivery fee increase from R$ 5 to R$ 7.50.

item.title: Poder360 lança o Poder História: fatos relevantes do Brasil e do mundo
item.description: Poder360 launches Poder História, an editorial section documenting historical events related to politics, economy, and power in Brazil and worldwide, featuring facts, anniversaries, and editorial changes. The initiative includes free access to the Time Machine, which archives front pages since 2000. It also offers Poder Drive, a subscription-based platform for corporate decision-makers to analyze strategic public issues.

item.title: Deus, chapéu de couro e abraço a mãe: como foi 1º ato de Flávio no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launched his campaign in the Northeast with a visit to Maceió, where he wore a leather hat alongside running mate Alfredo Gaspar. During the event, he made religious statements, attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and promised, vaguely, to transform the region's economy. The approach mixed symbolic gestures with criticism of the former president, without detailing concrete policies.

item.title: Lula e Flávio mostram o esgotamento dos debates
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, broadcast by Band, was marked by superficiality and a lack of substantive content. Of the six invited candidates, only Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and others made meaningful interventions, while Lula and Flávio remained defensive and failed to present concrete proposals.

item.title: Campanha na TV: As estratégias dos principais nomes nos 3 maiores Estados
item.description: In a heated presidential race with risks of a first-round conclusion, the performance of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the three largest electoral colleges in Brazil — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — becomes decisive for the national outcome. TV campaigns will play a central role in attracting undecided voters and mobilizing party bases.

item.title: O almoço decisivo para o fim definitivo da 'taxa das blusinhas'
item.description: Lula, Davi Alcolumbre, and Hugo Motta meet to announce the end of taxation on T-shirts. The measure aims to reduce the tax burden on basic clothing items.

item.title: ‘Faz o L?’: o que realmente significa o nome dado pela PF à operação sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police (PF) named 'Faz o L?' an operation investigating suspected influence peddling involving Fábio Luís da Silva, son of President Lula. The name sparked surprise and concern behind the scenes of the INSS investigation, fueling debates about press coverage and the public image of political figures. The report highlights the tension between institutional power and judicial probes in the Brazilian electoral landscape.

item.title: Caso Lulinha vira munição contra indicação de Jorge Messias ao STF
item.description: The 'Lulinha case' is used to criticize the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, after he rejected a PF request to challenge decisions by Minister André Mendonça. The incident caused tension between institutions and is leveraged by Messias' allies to question his performance.

item.title: Anúncios eleitorais descumprem regras do TSE e miram Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e STF
item.description: Paid political ads on social media have been circulating since the start of the 2026 election campaign, many violating TSE rules by attacking opponents and institutions such as Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and the STF. This reflects challenges faced by the TSE in monitoring and removing irregular content promptly, as well as weak sanctions to prevent further violations.

item.title: PL usa fundação do partido para turbinar caixa em ano eleitoral
item.description: The PL, party of Flávio Bolsonaro, would have used the Alvaro Valle Institute to increase its electoral funding in election years, exploiting gaps in legislation. Between 2023 and 2026, the mechanism would have generated $115 million for the party, equivalent to 70% of all returns from other parties.

item.title: Por que mulheres e homens votam cada vez mais diferente — e como isso pode definir eleição entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Women, the majority of voters, are increasingly splitting their votes differently from men, favoring Lula while Flávio Bolsonaro faces challenges from inheriting his father's rejection. This gender voting divide could be decisive in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Flávio mira Michelle e Tarcísio ao defender fim da reeleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates for the end of re-election to mobilize right-wing leaders, including Michelle Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Nikolas Ferreira, in his 2026 presidential campaign. Strategies aim to align interests, but the three have future presidential projects, limiting their current engagement.

item.title: “Emendas são extravagância fiscal”, diz coordenador de Caiado
item.description: Roberto Brant, coordinator of Ronaldo Caiado's government plan, advocates fiscal adjustment with expenditure ceiling and criticized parliamentary amendments as 'fiscal extravagance'. The plan aims for fiscal balance within one year with progressive surplus until 2030.

item.title: Após encontro discreto com Lira, Flávio faz 2º dia de giro por AL sem JHC
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro continued his second day of campaigning in Alagoas without publicly meeting JHC and Arthur Lira, focusing on events with supporters and business leaders. A discreet meeting with Lira occurred during a religious service, while the strategy avoids direct exposure to protect the local candidates’ own races.

item.title: Novo salário mínimo reajusta benefícios e impacta contas públicas. Entenda
item.description: The federal government projects the minimum wage at R$1,741 for 2027, a 7.4% increase from the current R$1,621. The adjustment affects various social benefits and public expenditures, including pensions, BPC, unemployment insurance, and contributions from self-employed workers and individual micro-entrepreneurs, increasing mandatory budget expenses. The impact is already included in the 2027 Budget Bill, to be sent to Congress by August 31st.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Motta e Alcolumbre por taxa das blusinhas e prioridades
item.description: President Lula meets with Congressional leaders to discuss approval of the Provisional Measure eliminating import tax on international purchases up to $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', before its expiration deadline of September 8th. The meeting aims to secure congressional support to prevent the tax from returning, which could negatively impact Lula's reelection campaign.

item.title: Raquel Lyra x João Campos: mapa indica quem "controla" cada cidade de PE
item.description: Map data shows Raquel Lyra leads with 139 city endorsements versus João Campos' 40. A Quaest poll indicates a statistical tie in voter intentions. Municipal support reflects strategic party alliances.

item.title: A armação fake de Bia Kicis: vídeo cortado e ataque vil a Lula
item.description: Federal congresswoman Bia Kicis (PL-DF), pre-candidate for the Senate in the Federal District, was criticized for manipulating a video of President Lula to label him an atheist. The episode was repudiated on Noblat's show, with accusations of dishonesty and misleading manipulation to win votes.
